A full card image with the corrected text and a white E in the lower border, from the Players Committee's Holotable image set (8 July 2018).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Ref3-D-maulsdoublebladedlightsaber-PC-Errata-2018-E-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Maul's Double-Bladed Lightsaber]]: The game text changes: “May” becomes “While on Maul, may”. The text box is set again with the corrected text, and a white italic “E” is added in the lower border (490 × 352 pixels).

The whole printed card image and the whole 2018 E card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
